subject: The feature 87% of users miss until week 3
preview_text: Most users skip this one-tap trick, but it saves hours. Check your app now.
body_paragraphs: I was on a call last Tuesday at 2PM, drowning in action items. Then I remembered something I built months ago—and forgot to tell you about. It's the feature most users don't touch until they're desperate, and by then, they've already lost a week of clarity.

Here's the thing: your brain can't hold every key point from a 45-minute meeting. But Smart Notes can—and it's already sitting in your app, waiting. The 87% stat isn't made up; it's from our actual data. Users who find this early cut their note-taking time in half by day 3.

It's called the 'Quick Summary' mode. Open the app, tap the blue mic icon before your next meeting, and let it listen. You don't need to press record, name the session, or even open the transcript. It auto-generates a structured summary with action items, ready to share.

Your move: Open Smart Notes now and start a test recording of your next call—even if it's a 2-minute chat. The relief of never missing a key point again is one tap away. P.S. — Users who try this once have a 73% higher retention rate by day 7. Don't be the one who skips it.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes - AI Meeting Summary
